query: Bonded warehouses imported automotive parts tariff deferral

statements.text: Bonded warehouses allow importers to defer duty payments for up to five years, freeing up capital that would otherwise be tied up in customs duties.
One of the standout benefits is the five-year duty deferral period, which allows businesses to keep cash available for essential investments instead of tying it up in immediate tax payments.

A customs bonded warehouse is a secured facility authorized by U.S. Customs and Border Protection where imported dutiable merchandise may be stored for up to five years from the date of importation without immediate payment of duties.
Unlike Foreign-Trade Zones, bonded warehouses apply the duty rate in effect at the time goods are withdrawn, not when they enter the warehouse.
Whether you're dealing with pharmaceutical cold chains, automotive parts, or general merchandise, the potential to turn fixed import costs into strategic advantages is enormous.
